_doc: Jin training combos. ideal = target frame offset from the FIRST input (60fps frames). window = tolerance in frames. Timings marked approximate are starting points — tune them to what works in-game.

combos.name: Electric Wind God Fist drill
combos.note: → N ↓ ↘+Y (f,n,d,df+2) — press Y on the SAME frame as ↘. The overlay shows your ↘→Y gap in ms.

combos.name: 1,2 — Left Right Combo
combos.note: Basic rhythm. 1 jails into 2 with up to 4f delay.

combos.note: Timing approximate — adjust ideal frames after labbing.
